event: "Well, you might want to hurry up then, Firrelia!" Nala grunts through her teeth.
The blue words give no answer; they thin and fade out of the air.
She throws herself forward from the ground, over the beast, arms reaching for its neck.
The instant her body touches its back, the flat quills spring up all at once.

memory.fact: A rushing shardback lays its quills flat to run; they bristle up the instant its back is touched.

event: Glass drives into her forearms and the insides of her arms, a spray of small, bright cuts.

changes.note: Quill shards drive into her arms as the bite grinds on: 24

event: She gets her arms round it anyway, but its neck is short and thick, and quilled at the nape.
Her grip will not close; there is nothing like a neck there to squeeze, only muscle and glass.

memory.fact: A shardback's neck is short and thick, quilled at the nape, with nothing there to grip or squeeze.
A shardback's neck is short and thick, quilled at the nape, with nothing there to grip or squeeze.

event: The beast twists under her, and every twist snaps off more shards into her skin.

memory.fact: Arms locked round a shardback's back or nape take quill shards with every twist it makes.
Arms locked round a shardback's back or nape take quill shards with every twist it makes.

event: Its jaws stay locked on her calf the whole time, grinding.
Her hands slide down its front as it heaves, over skin that is suddenly soft and bare.
Its throat and belly have no quills at all, and its jaw sits just above her fingers.

memory.fact: A shardback's throat and belly are soft, bare skin with no quills at all.
A shardback's throat and belly are soft, bare skin with no quills at all.

event: Her arms are running with blood, her grip is slipping, and it is still hanging on.
